newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares fall, market takes break.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares fall, market takes break.

text.p: Norwegian shares fell 0.55 percent on Wednesday in what dealers saw partly as profit-taking after the recent rally.
The Total index closed at 919.05 to trade in negative territory for the second consecutive day following an 11-day string of record closes.
Turnover was a moderate 663 million crowns.
"It is a healthy correction," one dealer said. "The market needed to take a break after being bullish for almost two weeks."
Dealers agreed some profit-taking had taken place.
Norsk Hydro fell 0.3 percent to 318.50 crowns, Aker A shares were down 1.8 percent at 140 crowns and Petroleum Geo-Services slipped 3.0 percent to 245.50 crowns.

Food-based conglomerate Orkla was down 2.5 percent to 424 crowns after a Norwegian newspaper report that Danish brewery Carlsberg and Coca-Cola may dominate softdrinks distribution in Scandinavia in a few years.
